{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n['id']: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        p = n['parent']
        if p is not None:
            children[p].append(n['id'])
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removal_order = []
    # sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    order = sorted(node_map.values(), key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    for n in order:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid == 'root':
            continue
        if n['symbol'] in required_symbols:
            continue
        if not n['removable']:
            continue
        # check if any child is still retained (implies subtree retained)
        if any(cid in retained for cid in children[nid]):
            continue
        # check if after removal, all required symbols are still present
        # since we never remove required-symbol nodes, and we only remove
        # leaves or entire subtrees that have no retained descendants,
        # the condition is automatically satisfied. But double-check:
        # we can check that for each sym in required_symbols,
        # there is at least one node in retained that has that symbol
        # after hypothetical removal. However, to be safe, we do the check.
        # Simulate removal of this node and its subtree.
        # We can compute the set of nodes that would be removed (this node and all descendants)
        # but we don't have descendant list precomputed. Since we are processing deepest first
        # and we know all descendants are already removed (no retained children), the only nodes
        # removed are this node itself. Because if a child is still retained, we skip.
        # So only this node is being removed. So just check if its symbol is not the only one for a required symbol.
        # But if there are multiple nodes with same required symbol, removing this node (if it had that symbol)
        # would be prohibited because we already checked symbol not in required_symbols. So safe.
        removal_order.append(nid)
        retained.remove(nid)
    # ensure all required symbols are still present (should be true)
    # final retained list sorted
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {'retained_ids': retained_sorted, 'removal_order': removal_order}
"
}
